scope: Controlled same-major PostgreSQL patch for the development/setup VPS. The original self-hosted/v0.8.4 vendor snapshot and its provenance remain unchanged.

officialSources.note: Supabase documents the 17.6 to 17.11 security update and required ltree/float GiST, legacy PGP and estimator checks. The selected stable17.12 image is a later same-major patch.
Keep reviewed versioned images, back up data independently, and check breaking changes; do not use floating tags or unattended arbitrary engine upgrades.
Compare actual collation versions after an in-place engine update. Rebuild dependent indexes before refreshing a changed version.

compatibilityAudit.sourceSecurityBackportEvidence: No evidence of backported17.11 fixes was established; the measured source engine reports17.6 and the immutable source image predates the advisory.
compatibilityAudit.imageBootstrapCompatibility: The old image has gosu; the new image has su-exec. The isolated recovery helper explicitly supports either reviewed executable. The runtime uses the image-owned entrypoint.
afterLiveUpgradeRequired: Verify exact running image and server version.
Check stored and actual collation versions in every database. If any differ, rebuild affected database indexes before refreshing that database collation version. Never refresh before rebuilding.
Run actual Auth/PostgREST/Storage/Realtime/Edge/frontend acceptance and confirm existing account and file persistence.

validation.method: isolated local reviewed-image PostgreSQL restore; no network/host ports; every Storage file verified byte-for-byte against source SHA256 inventory
validation.source: Latest complete private offsite development VPS backup; archive checksums and safe Storage extraction verified.
limitations: No Auth/Storage HTTP services or frontend were started against this restored copy.
Logical restore rebuilds indexes; an in-place image upgrade must separately reindex all affected databases and refresh collation versions when ICU changes.
Runtime secrets, role passwords and Vault encryption keys require their separate secure recovery source.
This development restore does not establish production recovery time or future 100GB restore capacity.

automaticUpdatePolicy: Only immutable engine pins with this reviewed provenance and a successful candidate restore may enter a release. PostgreSQL major upgrades, arbitrary runtime/configuration changes, failed checks or changed collations stop for a separately reviewed upgrade.

limitations: Development/setup acceptance only; no future100GB capacity or production availability acceptance.
Auth invitation and recovery delivery were captured by private Mailpit; no external SMTP delivery was configured or tested.
